read: FSD S5 v3 Requirements served; Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 BR-030; Business Requirements Program v4 REQ-S5-009 and REQ-S5-010; split_plan.json; Template and Rules v1 R9.
confirm: The business analyst and the traceability manager
impact: The trace is complete from the requirement to the tests and step D1 can renumber without a rewrite; no code, contract or test changes.

text: The legacy Data, Endpoints and Screen rows are read as corrected: the step reads no v_ace_* view and no recovery_case, decision_log_entry, rule_row or template row; the case state and the template arrive on their owners' contracts; the listing and the asset are read and written on the business-key asset paths; the SCR-23 states Draft, below limit, approved and published are business conditions of the approval and the floor check shown on the screen rather than values of LOV-LISTING; and the `asset` row the listing hangs from is read as S5's from Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1 although the Ownership Map table list omits it.
why: Every v_ace_* view is P1's, recovery_case is P3's, decision_log_entry and rule_row are P7's and template is P6's, the two legacy asset paths are superseded, the legacy screen states do not match LOV-LISTING, and the `asset` row has no Ownership Map row while three sources give it to S5.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-034 Data, Endpoints and Screen and states tables; Ownership Map v1 (P1 views, P3 recovery_case, P7 decision tables, P6 template, ASM-A6-api-6, ASM-A6-api-15, no asset row); Architecture v5 slides 19, 29, 37, 41 and 45; TSD S5 v2 T3.1 and T3.2; API Specification v4.
confirm: The solution architect and the data steward
impact: The step is testable on its own schema from Day 1, every foreign fact crosses one contract only, and no statement of this build can reach another owner's table or view.

text: The path parameter of the two asset reads and of the listing create is the ACE asset business key, as API Specification v3 and v4 declare it and as the business-key ruling of the Ownership Map carries it, and the app story resolves it on its own row; the uuid id of `asset` stays the internal record key, the two old asset-id rows and the TSD endpoint inventory are recorded for correction, and API-S5-005 keeps the listing identifier.
why: API Specification v3 and v4 and the FSD speak of the ACE asset_key while the Ownership Map rows, the TSD endpoint inventory and the legacy story keep the asset-id form, and a contract cannot declare a path parameter that no column can resolve without naming the default.
read: API Specification v4 /assets and /assets/{assetKey}; Ownership Map v1 rows GET /assets/{assetId} and POST /assets/{assetId}/listings with ASM-A6-api-15, and POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds; TSD S5 v2 T3.1, T3.3 and appendix T-A.1; FSD S5 v3 A2.25.3.2; Architecture v5 slide 41.
confirm: The solution architect and the data steward
impact: The screens and the app story keep the business key the ACE fact uses, the internal key stays internal, and the correction of the Ownership Map and the TSD is a documentation act rather than a second contract.

text: The service owns two published events under the Architecture catalogue, AssetTakenOn and AssetSold, and the broker route step publishes neither: AssetTakenOn belongs to the take-on story and AssetSold to the sale story that records the sale. The contract baseline therefore declares no event element, no producer role and no outbox row for this step, names TSD S5 T5.3 as the source that lists one event only, and leaves the correction of that list to the sale story and the catalogue owner.
why: R-PREC puts the Architecture v5 catalogue first and it gives two events to the topic, while the module technical specification gives one, and neither the take-on nor the sale belongs to this step, so the boundary has to be stated rather than inferred from either list.
read: Architecture v5 slides 19 OUT, 41, 42 and 43 (event 22, the AssetSold row and the envelope notes); TSD S5 v2 T5.3; Template and Rules v1 R3.
confirm: The solution architect and the event owner
impact: The step writes no outbox row and cannot publish a duplicate of an event its sibling stories own, and the two lists are reconciled by the owners rather than by this slice.

text: The two stories and their contract baseline are used while they sit in Draft (realignment v1) under D-RCV-60 with no approval record; the deprecation window of a published property and the retention of the contract fakes stay open for the solution architect, and the requirement cited by this slice is REQ-S5-010 read with REQ-S5-009 and BR-030.
why: No human approval is recorded for this run under the D-RCV-60 overlay, no source fixes a deprecation window or a fake retention period, and the split plan carries no requirement id for the slice.
read: Root AGENTS.md rules 1 to 14 and the D-RCV-60 overlay; Template and Rules v1 R1 U8 and R9; Architecture v5 slide 42; TSD S5 v2 appendix T-B; FSD S5 v3 Requirements served; Epics 3 to 8 BRD v1 BR-030.
confirm: The solution architect and the governance lead
impact: The baseline unblocks Day-1 work on both stories and the three open values are recorded for the architect; no approval is claimed that does not exist.

text: The DISPOSAL package reaches the route step through the rwb-decision package contract at its version in force, fetched at the start of the step and held for the evaluation, with its package code and version written to the decision record; the row is declared as consumed with the operation name as a placeholder, and no event is subscribed, no DP-04 row is added to the plan's pattern set and no rule row or rule package row is written by this service.
why: The step evaluates rules of the DISPOSAL package, while the event catalogue does not push RulePackageInForce to rwb-asset, Architecture v5 slide 19 IN names no rule-package feed and DP-04 is absent from the pattern set of this key, so the delivery path of the package has to be named.
read: Architecture v5 slides 19, 43 row 30 and 44 JOB-20; Temporal and Drools Design slides 15 and 16; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04; TSD S5 v2 T2 and T4; FSD S5 v3 A2.25.3.1; Ownership Map v1 (rule_package, rule_package_version and rule_row owner P7).
